title: Add Test Command with Testable Entity ID Scope
description: Introduce a general `test [{{testable-id-or-uri}}]*` command that runs all tests for all given entities. Add DefinitionKindTest (🧪️) as a new definition kind for test functions in test files. Implement entity ID resolution for projects, bundles, files, sections, and test definitions to determine scope. Group test files by language/runtime and run with appropriate test runner (go test, pytest, vitest/jest, dotnet test, cargo test). Add tests for the new command and definition kind.
summary: Implemented the test [testable-id-or-uri]* command for the repo CLI. Added DefinitionKindTest (🧪️) as a new definition kind with code t and integer 3 for SQLite. Updated buildDefinitionID to auto-detect test functions in lab files. Implemented full scope resolution from emoji IDs at project/bundle/file/section/definition levels with language-aware test runners (Go/Rust/C#/TypeScript/Python). Registered testCommand in NewRootWithConfig. Added comprehensive tests. All tests pass.
